job.job_description:
Job Role & responsibilities:-



Research, build, and deploy AI models as part of the broader AI team, leveraging AIops and MLOps practices for efficient model management
Contribute to our DevOps practices using OpenShift or Azure ML DevOps



Technical Skills, Experience & Qualification required:-



3-6 years of progressive experience in AI and ML, with a focus on AIOps and MLOps
Experience in deploying and managing AI models in production environments using Databricks, MLFlow, Azure ML
Implementation of at least 3-5 AI projects, preferably with experience in AIOps and MLOps
Experience in MLOps, MLflow and Databricks
Experience with Azure, OpenShift, Databricks, MLFlow
DevOps for model deployment, monitoring, and management
Setting up CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tech LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering
Broad understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques, including LLMs/SLMs, CNNs) RNNs, transformers, and attention mechanisms



Immediate Joiners will be preferred only
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and LLM experience with transferable cloud skills.
